text.en: This Act may be cited as the Business Names Act. title

In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires - "business" includes trade and profession; name" means the name, style, title or under which any business is carried on whether in partnership or otherwise; "firm" means an unincorporated body of two or more individuals, or one or more individuals and one or more corporations, or two or more corporaor which have entered into partnership "individual" means a natural person and does not include a corporation; "prescribed" means prescribed by the regulations; "the register" means the register directed to be kept in pursuance of section 16; means the Registrar of Business Names appointed under section 3; "regulations" means regulations made under this Act. B.L.R.O. 111984 4 CAP. 92

{1) His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan fit and proper person to be the Registrar of Business Names under and for the purposes of this Act.

(2) The Registrar shall have a seal of such design as may be approved by the Minister.

(3) In1pressions of such seal shall be judicially noticed and admitted in evidence. ( 4) Any act or thing directed to be done by or to the Registrar may be done by or to any officer authorised by the Minister.

heading.en: Statement to be signed by persons registering

text.en:
(1) The particulars required to be furnished under this Act shall be furnished before the firm, individual, or corporation commences business or the business in respect of which registration is required, as the case may be: Provided that, in the case of any firm, individual, or coror which has been carrying on business before the commencement of this Act and continues so to do after such commencement, registration shall be effected under the Act within 30 days of such commencement.

(2) If such firm, individual, or corporation carries on business without such registration being effected the firm, or corporation required to register as provided in this Act shall, without affecting any liability imposed under be under a continuing obligation so to register, and notwithstanding anything to the contrary in any written law, may be proceeded against in respect of any default accor-

heading.en: Business name always to be used

text.en:
(1) The business name under which any firm, indior corporation is registered under this Act shall be name always used in all matters connected with or relating to the business on by such firm, individual, or corporation and shall be painted or affixed on the outside of every office or place in which the business is carried on in a conspicious position in letters easily legible.

(2) If any firm, individual, or corporation fails to comply with this section every such individual or corporation and every member of such firm shall be guilty of an offence: Penalty, a fine of $250 and in the case of a continuing offence a further fine of not more than $25 for every day such offence continues.
